title: Russian Drone Attack Sinks Ship in Romanian Territorial Waters
detail: Ukraine reported that a Russian drone attack sank a ship in Romanian territorial waters, marking a significant escalation that directly involves a NATO member state. The incident risks triggering Article 5 consultations within NATO. Romania, which borders Ukraine to the southwest along the Black Sea and Danube Delta, has previously had drones land in its territory during Russian attacks on Ukrainian river port infrastructure. This incident represents a direct threat to the sovereignty of a NATO ally, raising the specter of alliance-wide defensive obligations under the North Atlantic Treaty.

title: Ukraine Launches Largest Drone Attack on Moscow in Two Years
detail: Moscow was struck in what is described as Ukraine's largest drone attack on the Russian capital in two years. The mass overnight assault signals a new phase in Ukraine's long-range campaign, demonstrating increased reach and volume of Ukrainian strike drone production.

title: Bulgaria Denounces Drone Attack on Two Black Sea Ships as 'Absolutely Unacceptable'
detail: Bulgaria formally denounced a drone attack on two of its ships in the Black Sea, calling it 'absolutely unacceptable.' The incident marks a new escalation threatening NATO-adjacent shipping beyond Ukrainian territorial waters, raising concerns about spillover of the conflict into waters involving NATO member states.
